# Taffy fixtures excluded from the conformance suite (TestTaffyFixtures),
# one per line: "category/name: reason". The reasons:
#
#   margin collapsing (ADR-006)   Chromium collapses adjoining vertical
#                                 margins; Tela does not. The test still lays
#                                 these out and checks that they differ from
#                                 Chromium and that margins can collapse in
#                                 them, so a stale entry fails the test.
#   box-sizing: content-box       Tela is always border-box (ARCHITECTURE 9).
#   flex-wrap: balance            CSS Flexbox 2 draft (flex-wrap: balance,
#                                 flex-line-count), not in Tela's CSS subset.
#   float                         Not implemented (ARCHITECTURE 10).
#   vertical writing modes        Not in Tela's CSS subset (ARCHITECTURE 10).
#   legacy -webkit text-align block alignment
#                                 text-align: -webkit-center/left/right moving
#                                 block children: text-align is not layout's
#                                 concern in Tela.
#
# The test checks that every fixture using an unsupported feature is listed
# with that feature as its reason.
